title: Petition of Camper Tours, Inc., pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7, requesting a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire restricted to sightseeing to and from the Wrentham, Foxboro, Bellingham area and the Towns of Plymouth, Bourne, Sandwich, Falmouth, Mashpee, Barnstable, Yarmouth, Dennis, Harwich, Brewster, Orleans, Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro and Provincetown.
